'''Cecil Vane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who operated [[The Credit Chip]] casino on [[Sel Zonn Station]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] business owner, Cecil Vane operated [[The Credit Chip]] [[Casino/Legends|casino]] over [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]]. Running a clean business, despite the fact that the house typically received more [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] then guests, Vane himself had never been accused of cheating his patrons. All this changed however when the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] came to power; After growing unhappy with the Empire's presence, Vane began cheating the casino's Imperial patrons.<ref name="TTG" />
